The '''destruction of Otoh Sancture''' was an attack on the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Sancture]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] that had broken out between the various tribes of the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] Gungan race that took place in [[3000 BBY]]. Before its destruction, Otoh Sancture had been a peaceful city and its leader, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], had taken a pacifist stance in the war and refused to fight other Gungans. However, this concerned Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the Gungan Boss behind the war, who believed that if Gallo joined the fighting he would drastically change the tide of it. To ensure this would not happen, Rogoe ordered a colony of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], a dangerous [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Naboo, to destroy Otoh Sancture and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Gallo.

However, Gallo happened to be away from the city on a [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] for animals for the [[Sacred Feast]], a Gungan thanksgiving celebration, when the bursas arrived and destroyed the city. Gallo observed the attack from afar, mourning the loss of his city without the knowledge of who was responsible. He then retreated into the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and discovered that it was Rogoe who had destroyed his city, prompting him to raise a small [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]] to [[Battle of Otoh Sancture|take]] Otoh Sancture's ruins back from the bursas, beginning his campaign to destroy Boss Rogoe, unite the Gungans, and bring peace to Naboo.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|All the Gungan tribes were always poundin' the other, but Gallo refusen to raisen his arms against hisen fellow Gungans|Rugor Nass|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:OtohSancture.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Otoh Sancture before its destruction]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> a large [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in which the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] tribes ceaselessly fought each other. [[Otoh Sancture]] was the only Gungan [[City/Legends|city]] that had refused to take part in the war, a stance enforced by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], the city's leader, who believed that the Gungans should not have been [[Death/Legends|killing]] each other. However, Gallo's neutrality concerned Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who secretly controlled the war for his own purposes, because he believed that he would be destroyed if Gallo chose to intervene. As a preventative measure Rogoe ordered a colony of carnivorous [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]] under his influence to attack Otoh Sancture, overseen by one of his [[Unidentified militiagung (Otoh Sancture)|militiagungs]]. At the time the city was about to enter into its [[Sacred Feast]], a Gungan celebration of thanksgiving to the [[Gud/Legends|Guds]], the Gungan [[Deity/Legends|deities]]. Tradition ruled that Gallo, as the Boss of Otoh Sancture, was to venture out into the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] to find some [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], antlered animals that would be suitable for the feast. Due to the [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]], Gallo was away from the city when the bursas arrived and began their attack.<ref name="GB" />

==The destruction==
{{Quote|Oh no, Bursas! Wesa under attack! Help!|One of Otoh Sancture's [[Unidentified Gungan villager (Otoh Sancture)|citizens]]|<ref name="GB" />}}
The bursas began to attack the city not long after its Boss left. Gallo returned to discover his city was under attack but found he was not able to get past the river crossing between the forests and his city. The residents of Otoh Sancture were completely unaware of why they had been targeted by the bursas. The creatures destroyed everything in Otoh Sancture; no Gungans were left alive, and the city's [[glurrg]]s,<ref name="GB" /> [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="CSWE Glurrg entry">{{CSWECite|I|347|Glurrg}}</ref> workers used in most Gungan cities, were also killed. Gallo eventually had to turn away and retreat into the forest as the bursas demolished the rest of the city.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Battle of Otoh Sancture}}
{{Quote|Who are yousa, Gungan. Why do yousa lead deesen creatures against yousa fellow Gungans?''"<br />"''Not mesa Gallo. Boss Rogoe orderen yousa death.''"<br />"''Boss Rogoe? Bah, why do yousa spake such lies.''"<br />"''Not lies, truth. Rogoe liven, and hesa sent the bursas to pound yousa for good.|Gallo questions a militiagung on the massacre of his people by the bursas|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:OtohSancture1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Gallo retakes Otoh Sancture.]]
The bursas that had attacked the city took residence on the ruins and created several nests. When Gallo retreated into the forests he met [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]], a rogue Gungan whom Gallo told about the destruction of his city. He also encountered Rogoe's [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]], who had unintentionally remained in the area for too long. When questioned by Gallo the militiagung denied responsibility for the Destruction of Otoh Sancture, identifying Rogoe was the perpetrator and explaining the warlord's motives. After that meeting, Gallo rebuilt Otoh Sancture in a new location and eventually raised an [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]] large enough to [[Battle of Otoh Sancture|defeat]] the bursas living in Otoh Sancture's remains. Marsune then returned to join Gallo in his campaign to defeat Rogoe and unite the Gungan tribes, which they succeeded in. Gallo then built [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], the Gungan [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city in memory of those killed in Otoh Sancture. The events of Gallo's fight against Rogoe, including the Destruction of Otoh Sancture, were later chronicled by Gallo's descendant [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Otoh Sancture was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> In the game itself it is the first event that happens in the Gungan campaign in the level "Otoh Sancture." When the level starts the player can only control Boss Gallo and is on a different side of a river than Otoh Sancture, meaning they can not actually send Gallo there. The bursa attack begins once the player finds the nerfs, and ends when they reach Marsune's camp. The name of the battle is given in Marsune's entry in the game's DataBank.<ref name="GB" />
